faq.q: Can I make a TikTok ad from just one product photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo, share your idea in one sentence and pick 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. The credit cost shows before the clip is made.

faq.q: How long should my TikTok ad video be?
faq.a: AIVideosUGC makes clips of 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, all in the vertical 9:16 shape. Pick the length that fits the offer and keep the product in view from the first frame.

faq.q: Do I have to book a creator or a studio?
faq.a: No. The clip is built from your own product photo, so there is no creator to book, no shoot day and no wait for footage. Make a new version whenever you need a different opening.

faq.q: Does the video include music and captions?
faq.a: No. The download has no sound or captions, so add a sound and your caption in TikTok or CapCut, then upload the file to Ads Manager.

faq.q: Can I send the video straight to TikTok Ads Manager?
faq.a: No. Download the file first, then upload it yourself in TikTok Ads Manager or the TikTok app. That is also where you add captions, sound and your offer.
Use a sharp photo that shows the whole product. Leave a little space around it so TikTok's buttons and caption do not cover the item in the vertical clip.

faq.q: Can I make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. Run another job from the same photo with a different idea and get a new opening to test. You do not reshoot or pay for a second creator.

faq.q: Do I need to label the ad as AI-generated?
faq.a: TikTok's AI-content label can be required depending on the creative and market. Apply the label in Ads Manager when it asks for it.
